product_metadata.title: CARRIE HOME Buffalo Check Pillow Covers Buffalo Plaid Throw Pillow Cover 18x18 for Red and White Decorations, Set of 4
features: ★Wine Red Burgundy Color★ They're not Christmas red pillow covers, more like darker cranberry color. Set of 4 burgundy throw pillow covers 18x18 inch for couch. No Insert or Filler included.
★Maroon Throw Pillow Covers★ There is no pillow insert or filler included, so you need to buy the pillow inserts separately, 18x18 inch or 20x20 inch inserts are both okay.

★More like Decorative Pillow Covers★ Made of 100% polyester material, not soft a little rough but very durable, no fading or abrasion, can be used outdoors. Not suitable for use in bed, more suitable for decorating your patio furniture, porch or swing.

★High Quality Hidden Zipper★ Invisible zipper will not decrease the beauty of these outdoor wine red burgundy throw pillow covers. Hidden zipper on the edge is durable, works smoothly, and can easily withstand frequent disassembly and filling.
★Washing Tips★ Suggest washing before you use these red plaid throw pillow covers. Hand wash or machine wash separately in cold water on the gentle cycle, tumble dry low, do not bleach.
